goalInOwnWords: Build a line that turns scrap into money, fill the order every shift (six orders, all six is three stars) and finish with more money than Sal.
stoppedWhere: Home screen, right after sending the survey (completion code K2Y2-7M2D). Before that: the results screen of a try from shift 5 on the same yard, three stars, $15,625, Sal beaten by $2,801. The first full game today was 2 stars and $13,936. The second finished run was that try from shift 5, not a new yard.
stoppedWhy: I had won: three stars, Sal beaten, nothing left to chase on this yard. Then the game called that run practice that does not go on the board, so my stars stayed at 4 and Yard Hand stayed one star away. Replaying the same yard is the same buttons again and I was at my break limit. I would look at tomorrow's yard, not replay this one.

stuck.where: Shift 2 pick screen, the spare Shipping Dock
stuck.what: The lit spots covered the hopper and the crusher but the dock stayed on the shelf, with Sal saying 'put it where you think'. I did not know I had to place or sell it. The game let me start anyway and I finished $10 behind Sal.
stuck.gotOutHow: In shift 3 I tapped the spare dock on the shelf, saw 'Sell for $10', sold it and was level with Sal again.

stuck.where: Shift 4, the 'Furnace + Splitter + Dock' card that said 'No easy spot yet'
stuck.what: Where to put a second furnace with its splitter and dock. 'Move a machine to make room' did not say which machine. I built it by hand (about 14 taps, five of them just turning the splitter and the furnace) and the forecast ended at $2,139, $11 short of the order, exactly what it said before I built anything.
stuck.gotOutHow: Pressed Undo 9 times until the card screen came back, then took the green lit-spots card instead.

stuck.where: Shifts 3 to 5, the line 'You're level with Sal. The lit spots are his game: beat him by finding better.'
stuck.what: What 'finding better' than the lit spots meant and which of the 'no easy spot' cards would pay. In shift 5 the lit spots left me $254 short of the $3,200 order and Sal still said 'Ready? Start the shift.'
stuck.gotOutHow: I did not work it out. In shift 6 I gambled on the Plate Press (two $6 shards into one $48 plate) and the forecast went from $2,946 to $4,302.

confused: Home said 'No finished games yet' and '0 games played' although I played a whole game yesterday; my $9,840 was only inside the 'From earlier versions (v8)' fold-out, which I opened by guessing.
The results of my first game today said 'First game in the books' although it was my second.
'Lit spots: when you ask' on the job card: I did not know what asking meant (it turned out to be the 'Show me where' button).
The grey 'Next shift:' line on the pick screen: I only worked out it was a preview of the next cards after scrolling down in shift 4.
'From shift 4, plates sell for $42 too': too what?
'No easy spot yet. Move a machine to make room.' Which machine, and move it where? The yard looked half empty to me.
After picking a card one shelf part glowed blue but a different one (a dock) was the selected one, so my first tap on the yard put the wrong part on my belt.
Parts I placed myself came out facing the wrong way (the furnace 'Sends down', off the bottom edge) and needed one to three Turn taps each.
'Beat him by finding better': better how?
'Ready? Start the shift.' with a glowing Start button on a build the forecast says will miss the order.
A spare Shipping Dock left on the shelf after the lit spots, with no lit spot and no warning.
My three-star run was labelled 'practice (a try: doesn't go on the board)' while Home says there is no leaderboard in this test version: what board?
The green 'Clean' tag on the results: no idea what it means.
annoyed: About 14 taps to build a second furnace line the game called 'no easy spot yet', and the forecast did not move ($2,139 before and after).
Backing out of it took 9 Undo taps, one per placement and per turn, and there is no way to start the shift over.
My three-star run was called practice. It is not on Home (still best $13,936, 4 stars, one star short of Yard Hand).
Sal says 'Ready?' and the Start button glows when the forecast says I will miss the order.
The 'Show me where' button label is cut off at the screen edge ('Show me wher').
Four shifts of the same routine (green card, lit spots, Start, Skip) and the 37 ingots per shift never changed, so it felt like busywork until the plate press.
Home forgot yesterday's game until I opened the earlier-versions fold-out.
pleased: Four taps from Home to the first lit spot (Play, Start the job, pick a card, Show me where), no reading needed; the lit spots walk me through it.
The forecast line ('This shift will pay $4,302 (up $1,356)', 'That fills the $3,200 order') tells me before I start whether a move helps.
'Skip to the end of the shift': I never had to watch a conveyor.
Finding that selling the spare dock for $10 closed the gap to Sal, without being told.
'Try again from shift 5' dropped me straight back at the shelf with no questions.
Working out the plate press myself: $2,946 up to $4,302 on one shift, then three stars with Sal beaten by $2,801.
Sal's number on the Home and job screens gives me something to beat.
The Tips entries are short and have a little demo (furnace, splitter).
bestMoment: Shift 6 of the first run: I put the plate press where two crushers meet and the forecast jumped $1,356 on one machine. Then the retry from shift 5, 'That fills the $3,200 order' in green, and three stars with Sal beaten by $2,801.
worstMoment: Shift 4: about 14 taps building a second furnace, splitter and dock for a card that said 'no easy spot yet', the forecast did not move at all, then 9 Undo taps to back out of it.
oneChange: Let a better run from 'Try again from shift 5' count. My three-star run was called practice, so my stars stayed at 4 and Yard Hand stayed one star away. If beating the lit spots actually moved me up, I would play again.
